test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of India's first engineless train?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vande Bharat Express**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vande Bharat Express is an Indian high-speed intercity electric multiple unit train.
 
• It was designed and built by Integral Coach Factory (ICF) at Perambur, Chennai under the Indian government's Make in India initiative over a span of 18 months. 
 
• During trials, it attained a maximum speed of 180km/hr.
 
• The actual top speed is restricted to 130 km/hr due to the speed limit of the railway track of routes, which are used by Vande Bharat Express.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vande Bharat has an air-conditioned chair car service with 16 coaches.
 
• It is an engine-less self-propelled train set that allows for faster acceleration and deceleration.
 
• Vande Bharat Express operates five days a week except on Monday and Thursday and covers the distance between New Delhi and Varanasi in eight hours.
